title: Hazina Early Warning Platform
description: An AI-powered early warning and anticipatory action system synthesizing weather forecasts, IoT river sensors, and satellite imagery to trigger automated pre-disaster cash releases.
shortDescription: AI early warning platform triggering pre-disaster relief before floods and droughts hit.
challenge: In Kenya, climate-induced disasters such as flash floods along the Tana and Nzoia rivers traditionally triggered reactive emergency responses days after communities suffered devastating losses. Delay in funding and emergency alerts meant higher casualties, lost livestock, and severe economic disruption.
solution: The Digital Transformation team engineered Hazina—an integrated anticipatory action platform. Hazina aggregates real-time streamflow telemetry from 45 IoT river gauges, European Space Agency Sentinel-2 soil moisture feeds, and ECMWF weather models. When predefined hazard thresholds are breached, Hazina triggers automated mobile cash alerts via M-PESA to at-risk families 72 hours before floodwaters crest.
impact: Hazina provided 72-hour advance warnings during the 2024 El Niño rains across Tana River and Garissa counties, protecting over 45,000 households and disbursing over KES 1.8M in anticipatory cash transfers prior to inundation.

title: BomaCare Cash & Voucher Assistance Platform
description: An offline-first mobile and cloud application enabling secure household registration, biometric verification, and instant M-PESA mobile cash disbursements for displaced populations.
shortDescription: Offline-first mobile cash assistance & beneficiary management system.
challenge: Traditional humanitarian aid delivery relies on paper registers and physical food distribution centers, leading to security risks, long queues, high administrative overhead, and loss of dignity for beneficiaries in remote refugee camps and flood displacement sites.
solution: BomaCare was engineered to digitize the entire cash transfer pipeline. Field officers use offline-capable mobile tablets with encrypted local storage to register households, capture digital signatures, and verify identity. Once synced via cellular or satellite connections, BomaCare executes automated batch disbursements directly into beneficiaries' mobile wallets with real-time audit trails.
impact: Streamlined aid delivery times from 14 days down to 6 hours. BomaCare has processed over KES 15M in humanitarian cash grants to over 180,000 families with a 99.8% verification accuracy rate.

title: RedPulse Epidemic Analytics Engine
description: Real-time spatial epidemic surveillance system combining community health worker SMS alerts, laboratory feeds, and climate metrics to pinpoint disease outbreak hotspots.
shortDescription: Spatiotemporal epidemic tracking & outbreak prediction dashboard.
challenge: Outbreaks of cholera, dengue, and malaria in remote areas often went undetected for weeks due to fragmented health reporting, resulting in preventable fatalities and uncontrolled disease transmission across county lines.
solution: RedPulse aggregates data from 12,000+ community health volunteers sending structured SMS reports, DHIS2 national health facility data, and water quality telemetry. Using spatiotemporal cluster detection algorithms (SaTScan & PyTorch), RedPulse identifies statistical anomalies in syndrome reports and alerts county epidemiologists before outbreaks explode.
impact: Detected 4 cholera clusters in Mandera and Kilifi counties 11 days before official lab confirmation, allowing targeted water purification kit distribution that contained outbreaks locally.

title: ResilienceMap GIS & Vulnerability Atlas
description: Comprehensive 47-county GIS spatial database combining satellite imagery, terrain elevation models, and community socio-economic surveys to map climate vulnerability.
shortDescription: High-resolution geospatial atlas mapping climate risk and community resilience.
challenge: Disaster management authorities lacked localized, granular spatial data. County level planning often relied on national averages that obscured micro-vulnerabilities in informal urban settlements and arid rural villages.
solution: ResilienceMap integrated 10m-resolution European Space Agency satellite layers, drone elevation models, and OpenStreetMap building footprints into an open-access web GIS. It generates composite vulnerability indices based on flood exposure, distance to health facilities, clean water access, and household poverty headcount.
impact: Used by 14 county governments across Kenya to allocate emergency contingency funds and design targeted flood barrier infrastructure, protecting over 600,000 residents.

title: MamaAfya Mobile Health Toolkit
description: Multilingual smartphone application assisting community health workers with maternal health tracking, immunization schedules, and emergency obstetric referral dispatch.
shortDescription: Mobile app for community health workers providing maternal care & emergency dispatch.
challenge: High maternal and neonatal mortality in hard-to-reach pastoralist areas due to missed prenatal visits, unmonitored high-risk pregnancies, and delayed emergency transportation.
solution: MamaAfya equips community health volunteers with an intuitive Swahili and Somali audio-guided mobile application. The app guides volunteers through maternal health checklists, automatically schedules SMS reminders for mothers, and triggers emergency Red Cross ambulance dispatch when critical danger signs are logged.
impact: Over 68,000 pregnant women monitored across Garissa, Turkana, and Kilifi counties; 42% increase in facility-based skilled deliveries and zero maternal deaths among enrolled high-risk cohorts in 2024.

title: Rafiki AI Disaster Assistant & Chatbot
description: Generative AI conversational bot delivering real-time disaster guidance, first-aid instructions, and shelter locations via WhatsApp in Swahili, Somali, and Turkana.
shortDescription: Multilingual AI assistant delivering first-aid & evacuation instructions via WhatsApp.
challenge: During sudden emergency situations (earthquakes, flash floods), emergency call hotlines become severely overloaded, leaving thousands seeking evacuation routes and first-aid instructions stranded without answers.
solution: Rafiki AI leverages Large Language Models fine-tuned on Red Cross humanitarian first-aid guidelines and localized emergency protocols. Available via WhatsApp and SMS, Rafiki AI converses naturally in local dialects, parses location pins, and provides step-by-step guidance while escalating critical cases to human hotline agents.
impact: Handled over 320,000 user conversations during the April 2024 floods, reducing Red Cross 1199 emergency call center queue times by 65%.
